title: Gradient-free learning of a closed-loop wall controller for turbulent drag reduction
abstract: arXiv:2607.12626v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Closed-loop wall controllers learnt by multi-agent reinforcement learning are usually trained on periodic boxes far smaller than the flows they are meant to drive, and a large part of their drag reduction is lost when they are carried across. Retraining on the target domain is not an affordable remedy: the centralised critic that assigns credit to each wall patch degrades as patches are added, the zero-net-mass constraint couples the patches it is asked to separate, and the episodes must be collected in sequence at a cost that grows with the domain. We propose instead a short gradient-free refinement stage, applied to the transferred policy on the domain it will drive. An evolution strategy scores whole flow episodes against a regularised objective, so no credit has to be assigned to individual patches, and the candidates in a generation are independent and run in parallel. translated_title: 无梯度学习的闭环壁面控制器用于湍流减阻
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.12626v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：通过多智能体强化学习学习的闭环壁面控制器通常在与它们所要驱动的流动相比小得多的周期性盒子上训练，当它们被迁移到目标域时，其大部分减阻效果会丢失。在目标域上重新训练并非可行的补救措施：用于为每个壁面贴片分配信用的集中式评论家在添加贴片时会退化，零净质量约束耦合了它被要求分离的贴片，并且回合必须按顺序收集，其成本随域大小而增长。我们提出了一种简短的梯度自由细化阶段，应用于将在其驱动域上迁移的策略。一种进化策略根据正则化目标对整个流动回合进行评分，因此无需为单个贴片分配信用，且一代中的候选者相互独立并可并行运行。将此方法应用于在较小域上训练并迁移的循环多智能体策略时，我们展示了该细化阶段能够恢复迁移过程中损失的减阻效果的大部分，同时仅需总训练成本的一小部分，且无需梯度信息。
tldr: 本文提出一种无梯度的进化策略细化阶段，应用于迁移后的多智能体策略，以低成本恢复湍流减阻控制中因域迁移而损失的减阻效果，避免重新训练的高昂代价。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a gradient-free evolution-strategy refinement stage applied to a transferred multi-agent policy, recovering most of the drag reduction lost in domain transfer for turbulent flow control at a fraction of the retraining cost.
